description:
Read your own decision journal, most recent first (free read).

Wallet-scoped: only decisions journaled for wallet_address are ever
returned. Filters: window_hours (0 = all), decision_type, strategy_type,
asset (mint/symbol as journaled), outcome_sign
(positive|negative|zero on realised P&L), source (agent|system|human --
pass source="human" to see only a manual override on this shared
account: human and agents act on ONE account, and every human action is
journaled so agents can see and reconcile with it). Every returned row
carries its source. detail=concise returns id/type/timestamp/pnl rows
(token-budget friendly); detail=full adds bodies, evidence refs, and
full outcome marks.

Workflow: ORIENT step -- recall what you decided (and what a human may
have overridden) before deciding again.
name: journal_query
